native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'after first button press', 'state': {'btn1': 'pressed once', 'sevseg1': '3'}, 'description': 'After the initial button press, the counter increments by 3 from 0 to 3, and the 7-segment display shows 3.'}

test2: {'time': 'after second button press', 'state': {'btn1': 'pressed twice', 'sevseg1': '6'}, 'description': 'After the second button press, the counter increments by 3 from 3 to 6, and the 7-segment display shows 6.'}

test3: {'time': 'after third button press', 'state': {'btn1': 'pressed three times', 'sevseg1': '9'}, 'description': 'After the third button press, the counter increments by 3 from 6 to 9, and the 7-segment display shows 9.'}

test4: {'time': 'after 20 additional button presses', 'state': {'btn1': 'pressed 23 times total', 'sevseg1': '9'}, 'description': 'After 20 additional button presses (23 total), the counter increments by 3 each press, wrapping around after 9. The final count is (23 * 3) % 10 = 69 % 10 = 9, so the 7-segment display shows 9.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
